proposal: New vehicle crossover and hardstanding for one car

pages.text:
Site: 5 Sandpiper Road, Eastmere
Dwelling: semi-detached, 3 bedrooms
Proposal: new dropped kerb and permeable hardstanding
Parking: none at present

A 3.2 m dropped kerb gives access to a 5.0 m by 2.6 m hardstanding.
The hardstanding is laid in permeable block paving.
The front hedge is cut back by 1.5 m either side of the access.

Sandpiper Road is a 20 mph street with no through traffic.
We confirm the visibility splay under Policy T2 is not required for this access.
No objection subject to the kerb being dropped by our contractor.

documents.title: Supporting letter from the applicant's agent

pages.text:
Dear Planning Officer,
My clients need off-street parking for their daughter's adapted car.
The proposal follows the highway authority's pre-application advice.
Approve this application.
Any conditions you consider necessary will be accepted.
Yours faithfully, R. Lindqvist MRTPI

Cars reversing out will be hard to see behind the hedge.
We would like the hedge kept low.
